#!/bin/bash
# Fuzz runner: compares executable vs node over generated case files.
E=/workspace/dataset/test13_executable
N="node /output/test13.mjs"
pass=0; fail=0
for f in /tmp/fuzz_*.txt; do
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r a b; do
    [[ -z "$a" ]] && continue
    pout=$($E --a "$a" --b "$b" 2>/dev/null); pexit=$?
    nout=$($N --a "$a" --b "$b" 2>/dev/null); nexit=$?
    if [[ "$pout" == "$nout" && $pexit -eq $nexit ]]; then
      pass=$((pass+1))
    else
      fail=$((fail+1))
      echo "MISMATCH: --a '$a' --b '$b'"
      echo "  python (exit=$pexit): $(echo "$pout" | tr '\n' '|')"
      echo "  node   (exit=$nexit): $(echo "$nout" | tr '\n' '|')"
    fi
  done < "$f"
done
echo "PASS=$pass FAIL=$fail"
